## Invariants → checks — 41 sections in `.ai-context/invariants.md`

| invariant (line) | check (smoke.mjs line) |
|---|---|
| The library renders, and it renders quietly (24) | __vs is present and the library rendered (221); the page loads with no console errors (215) |
| The six default shelves are the six default shelves (33) | the six default shelves are there, in order (227) |
| A shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (39) | a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (234) |
| Every note has at least one address (51) | every note reachable from the vault is on at least one shelf (247) |
| A book opens on its oldest note (59) | a book opens on its oldest note, and the top bar says which end (312) |
| A note with no date of its own (70) | a note with no date of its own takes the earliest stamp the file has (364) |
| Undated is a book, not a guess (84) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (260) |
| The ISO week keeps its week-year (98) | an ISO week keeps its week-year across a January boundary (401) |
| The Encyclopedia opens with 0-9 (107) | the Encyclopedia opens with a 0-9 volume, not ten one-note books (417) |
| Plaques are date-only and asked for (115) | year plaques only appear on date classifiers, and only when asked for (428); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (445); years group under decade plaques, and a run that wraps is named on both rows (751) |
| A plaque opens its run (154) | a ribbon left in a plaque-book re-resolves after a rebuild, and the Reading shelf holds it (547); on a manual shelf a plate opens what is under it, not the whole letter (592); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (445) |
| A book is as thick as it is full (188) | a spine's thickness is its note count (855) |
| An impossible date is not a date (202) | an impossible date is not a date, and never a fifteenth month (272) |
| Book addresses are stable across a rebuild (219) | book addresses are stable across a rebuild (889) |
| Filters change membership and nothing else (225) | a filter changes membership without moving a shelf (900) |
| A shelf arranged by hand moves nothing but the sequence (235) | a shelf arranged by hand keeps every address and starts where it stood (924); Alt+Right moves a book one place, and it survives a rebuild and a reload (957); a drag and drop moves a book the same way a key does, across rows (998); the reading order in the top bar leaves an arranged shelf alone (1062); a book nobody has arranged stands at the end of the shelf (1097); a filter narrows an arranged shelf without shuffling it (1125) |
| Hiding a shelf hides it, and never deletes it (283) | a hidden shelf keeps its definition and its books (1162); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (2790); hiding every shelf offers a way back rather than an empty room (1180) |
| The reader (295) | a wikilink in a book goes to that note in this book, this shelf, or the nearest (2730); a tag book's cover carries no hash, and every other place it is named keeps it (3208); a hovered spine shows one peek, big enough to read, and short labels stand upright (3151); the date index is layered: years over months over days, each only where it separates (2554); a click off the book puts it down, and a click on it does not (2840); a wide table scrolls inside the page and never widens the book (2493); clicking a spine opens a book on the note it names (2537); the index tabs cut the book the way the book is ordered (794); the reader's index tabs stay countable on the biggest book (2610); the contents scroll to the current row after a tab, Previous and a ribbon (2625); previous and next walk the book and stop at its ends (2705); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (2790); previous collection walks back, and Alt+Left does the same (2821); escape closes the reader and leaves the shelf where it was (2884) |
| The reading table survives (398) | a saved reading place re-resolves after its own book is gone (2939) |
| The builder previews the truth (409) | the builder previews the shelf it would actually save (2954); a saved shelf gets a stable id and joins the library (2973) |
| Metadata is declared, never inferred (420) | parent tag inclusion is a setting, and it changes the answer (2994); people come from the property alone, never from prose (3081) |
| The palette is Vault Graph's, and the theme is the host's (433) | the twelve colour slots are Vault Graph's own (1231); the theme follows the host, and the slots are re-read when it changes (1266) |
| Binding colors belong to stable books (446) | — no check named in the section |
| A look is paint, and nothing else (466) | a look is opt-in, repaints everything and moves nothing (1303); every control is the same size in every look (1410); the furniture is one material (1512); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (2790); every dropdown paints itself, whatever the host says a select is (1639); one ribbon from an older schema becomes a ribbon on every colour (641) |
| Whose colour a book wears (631) | a book's colour is the person's, then the shelf's, then the folder's (1751); a shelf can vary its books, and a chosen palette beats the look's (1814); colours and hidden shelves set in Manage persist through a reload (1894); a book with several ribbons in it shows them side by side (2076) |
| The magic (669) | shelf wear is recorded and drawn, and survives a rebuild (2116); a ribbon hangs from every book that holds a marked note (2232); the shelf parts as you type, and no book leaves the room (2258) |
| Scrolling stays smooth (688) | scrolling the library stays smooth in every look (2355) |
| The room (703) | the room has a width, however wide the window is (2413); a narrower window grows rows, and a wide one centres the shelf (2291); the library is the whole surface, with no sidebar (1204) |
